links.outcome: Readability grade level of GPT-4 and clinician patient education materials
links.effect: GPT-4 Flesch-Kincaid mean 11.56 vs clinicians 12.67; Gunning Fog 12.47 vs 14.56; Coleman-Liau 15.90 vs 15.15. Grade levels remain high for patients.
links.quote: The observed lexical complexity suggests the need to refine outputs for populations with limited health literacy.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of AI-generated patient education materials
links.effect: GPT-4 readability scores were around grade 11.6 to 15.9 across indices, above typical patient reading levels, though somewhat better than clinician-created content on three of four indices.
links.quote: The observed lexical complexity suggests the need to refine outputs for populations with limited health literacy.

screen.reason: The study directly evaluates GPT-4 versus clinicians in generating personalized patient education guidance using retrospective patient profiles, without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
